title: 第7章 让师姐撞见了羞羞的事第8章 解开心结再来一次
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
大殿里。
只有烛火摇曳的声音。
林云陷入了纠结。
自己现在好像并不算很饥渴。
这两天一直和女帝祖师没羞没臊。
虽然他不是常人，几乎已经是仙人之下的第一人。
虽然他身体吃得消。
但是情绪上好像差了点什么。
是小师妹不诱人么？
林云低头看了看。
她穿着一身黑红纱裙，勾勒出纤细腰肢，长发散在肩头。
白嫩的脸颊微红，眼神有点羞涩中带着坚定。
林云挑了挑眉，声音带点调侃：“小师妹，你真的准备好了么？”
这种关键时刻，男人怎么能说不行呢！
林云准备强行开机。
柳雪琪咬了咬唇，身体软绵绵的靠在林云身上。
不知道从什么时候开始。
自己就满脑子都是师兄的身影。
在她眼中，师兄就是天上地下最好的男人。
虽然在别人看来，她的师兄只是一个不讲道理的大魔头。

但是从师兄把她捡回来的那天起。
她的命就是师兄的了。
自己的一切都是师兄给的。
柳雪琪知道，其实自己作为圣女，是有些不够资格的。
虽然她的修为勉勉强强还算过得去。
她的天赋其实也算不错，在师兄的帮助下，最终也达到了神通境。
但是距离天象境这个门槛，其实还有很远的距离。
但是师兄怕自己被欺负，怕自己受委屈。
硬是让自己淘汰了那些修为高深的亲传弟子成功上位。
回想着这些年来师兄对自己的点滴照顾。
柳雪琪心中没有丝毫的犹豫。
反而满是期待。
她的声音柔和，但是很认真。
“师兄，我真的已经练了阴阳合-欢圣典，而还到第三层了。”
“也许，明天大战凶多吉少，我想……我想跟你修炼，把修为提一提。”
说到后面，她脸红得像熟透的桃子，手指攥着裙角，眼底却透着点期待。
content_en:
In the main hall.
There was only the sound of flickering candlelight.
Lin Yun was entangled.
I don't seem to be very hungry right now.
In the past two days, I have been talking to the Empress Patriarch without any shame.
Although he is not an ordinary person, he is almost the first person among immortals.
Although his body can handle it.
But something seemed to be missing emotionally.
Isn't the little junior sister not attractive?
Lin Yun looked down.
She wore a black and red gauze skirt that outlined her slender waist, and her long hair was spread around her shoulders.
The fair and tender cheeks are slightly red, and the eyes are a little shy but firm.
Lin Yun raised his eyebrows and said in a teasing voice, "Junior sister, are you really ready?"
How can a man say no at such a critical moment?
Lin Yun was about to forcefully turn on the phone.
Liu Xueqi bit her lip and leaned softly against Lin Yun.
Don't know when it started.
His mind was filled with thoughts of his senior brother.
In her eyes, senior brother is the best man in the world.
Although in the eyes of others, her senior brother is just an unreasonable big devil.
But from the day the senior brother picked her up.
Her life belongs to her senior brother.
Everything I have is given by my senior brother.
Liu Xueqi knew that as a saint, she was somewhat unqualified.
Although her cultivation level is barely passable.
Her talent is actually quite good, and with the help of her senior brother, she finally reached the realm of supernatural powers.
But there is actually still a long way to go before the threshold of the Celestial Realm.
But the senior brother is afraid that he will be bullied and wronged.
He just forced himself to eliminate those direct disciples with advanced cultivation and succeeded in ascending to the throne.
Thinking back on all the care that my senior brother has given me over the years.
Liu Xueqi didn't hesitate at all.
Instead, it was full of expectations.
Her voice was soft but serious.
"Senior brother, I have really practiced Yin Yang He-Huan Sacred Code, and I'm still at the third level."
"Perhaps, tomorrow's battle will be a disaster. I think... I want to practice with you and improve my cultivation."
Speaking of the latter part, her face turned as red as a ripe peach, her fingers clenched the corners of her skirt, but there was a bit of anticipation in her eyes.
